# Artifact facet fixture provenance

`training_outcome.json` is an exact copy of the existing package-local
`../package/archive/training_outcome_port_explicit.json` DAG owner fixture.
`initial_refit.json` is an exact copy of `../initial_full_refit/package.json`.
Both pass their current owner `from_json` and `validate` APIs. They are control
contract fixtures using mock/host controllers, not native Methods fitting or
actual IO dataset composition evidence.

`capture/` is the exact output of the new direct `artifact_facets` example,
using an outcome and a package derived directly with
`TrainingOutcome::to_portable_predictor_package("package:facets",
AllowHostSidecar, HostSidecar)`. No old archive builder or reader was invoked.
The captured outcome/package inputs are preserved in `dagml/result.json` and
`dagml/model.json`. The inventory records SHA-256 and lengths of exact bytes.
The proof context is deliberately not serialized. Run/evidence/model controls
are validated; evaluation population and opaque fitted-state semantics are
unverified. There is no IO dataset or N4MM execution claim in this capture.

Producer source base: DAG HEAD `963abc4531789d6483e9d60d8d2e30549fc5ca9e`,
with the uncommitted `artifact_facets` owner implementation. Rust 1.88.0,
no optional native feature. Generate a new immutable capture with:

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/dagml-facets-target \
  cargo +1.88.0 run --locked -p dag-ml-core --example artifact_facets -- \
  crates/dag-ml-core/tests/fixtures/artifact_facets/capture/dagml/result.json \
  crates/dag-ml-core/tests/fixtures/artifact_facets/capture/dagml/model.json \
  /tmp/new-owner-facets
```

Actual integrated IO + native N4MM3 fixture generation and fresh-process
prediction belong to the external composition cohort. This capture must not be
used as qualification for those separate semantic claims.

The capture descriptor was regenerated by the direct producer for the five
typed-projection facet profiles (adding cache-set and execution-plan profiles).
Original owner payload members remain byte-identical. `links.json` now carries
an explicit non-authoritative diagnostic envelope; it is never an admission.

`native_role/` contains separately produced genuine native RolePipeline/N4ME
and child-refit owner inputs, with its own immutable provenance and generator
snapshots. Its current-source default tests exercise raw closure, recipe and
refit APIs. These do not confer IO identity or new evaluation claims.
